name: Ann Arbor
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Ann Arbor for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (Santa Photos at Briarwood Mall) through January 3 (Hands-On Holidays at the Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum), with Breakfast with Santa at the Ann Arbor Marriott Ypsilanti (November 29), PJs and Stories with Santa in Saline (December 1 and 3), the Chelsea Hometown Holiday Tree Lighting and Light Up Dexter (both December 4) and the Saline Holiday Parade (December 5) along the way. Ypsilanti, Saline, Chelsea and Dexter are folded into this page. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Ann Arbor

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Ann Arbor, including Ypsilanti, Saline, Chelsea and Dexter
  • 3 free events: the Saline Holiday Parade, Chelsea Hometown Holiday Tree Lighting and Light Up Dexter
  • Meet Santa: Briarwood Mall, the Ypsilanti Marriott breakfast, PJs and Stories in Saline, and the tree lightings in Chelsea and Dexter
  • Parades and tree lightings: Saline (December 5), Chelsea (December 4), Dexter (December 4)
  • Trains: Bill's Model Train Exhibit at the Hands-On Holidays event
  • Season: November 21 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Ann Arbor families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers America's Thanksgiving Parade, Winter at the Station and Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village.
